name: rsync
description: Rsync is a file transfer program capable of efficient remote update via a fast differencing algorithm

args.name: BACKUP
args.description: Mention files backed up

args.name: COPY
args.description: Mention files copied locally on the receiving side

args.name: DEL
args.description: Mention deletions on the receiving side

args.name: FLIST
args.description: Mention file-list receiving/sending (levels 1-2)

args.name: MISC
args.description: Mention miscellaneous information (levels 1-2)

args.name: MOUNT
args.description: Mention mounts that were found or skipped

args.name: NAME
args.description: Mention 1) updated file/dir names, 2) unchanged names

args.name: PROGRESS
args.description: Mention 1) per-file progress or 2) total transfer progress

args.name: REMOVE
args.description: Mention files removed on the sending side

args.name: SKIP
args.description: Mention files that are skipped due to options used

args.name: STATS
args.description: Mention statistics at end of run (levels 1-3)

args.name: SYMSAFE
args.description: Mention symlinks that are unsafe

args.name: ALL
args.description: Set all --info options (e.g. all4)

args.name: NONE
args.description: Silence all --info options (same as all0)

options.name: --checksum
options.description: Skip based on checksum, not mod-time & size

options.name: -c
options.description: Skip based on checksum, not mod-time & size

options.name: --backup-dir
options.description: Make backups into hierarchy based in DIR

options.name: -u
options.description: Skip files that are newer on the receiver

options.name: --update
options.description: Skip files that are newer on the receiver

options.name: --inplace
options.description: Update destination files in-place (SEE MAN PAGE)

options.name: --append-verify
options.description: Like --append, but with old data in file checksum

options.name: --safe-links
options.description: Ignore symlinks that point outside the source tree

options.name: --munge-links
options.description: Munge symlinks to make them safer (but unusable)

options.name: -k
options.description: Transform symlink to a dir into referent dir

options.name: --copy-dirlinks
options.description: Transform symlink to a dir into referent dir

options.name: -K
options.description: Treat symlinked dir on receiver as dir

options.name: --keep-dirlinks
options.description: Treat symlinked dir on receiver as dir

options.name: --copy-devices
options.description: Copy device contents as regular file

options.name: -S
options.description: Turn sequences of nulls into sparse blocks

options.name: --sparse
options.description: Turn sequences of nulls into sparse blocks

options.name: --preallocate
options.description: Allocate dest files before writing them

options.name: -n
options.description: Perform a trial run with no changes made

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Perform a trial run with no changes made

options.name: -e
options.description: Specify the remote shell to use

options.name: --rsh
options.description: Specify the remote shell to use

options.name: --rsync-path
options.description: Specify the rsync to run on the remote machine

options.name: --existing
options.description: Skip creating new files on receiver

options.name: --ignore-existing
options.description: Skip updating files that already exist on receiver

options.name: --delete
options.description: Delete extraneous files from destination dirs

options.name: --delete-before
options.description: Receiver deletes before transfer, not during

options.name: --delete-after
options.description: Receiver deletes after transfer, not during

options.name: --delete-excluded
options.description: Also delete excluded files from destination dirs

options.name: --ignore-missing-args
options.description: Ignore missing source args without error

options.name: --delete-missing-args
options.description: Delete missing source args from destination

options.name: --ignore-errors
options.description: Delete even if there are I/O errors

options.name: --force
options.description: Force deletion of directories even if not empty

options.name: --max-delete
options.description: Don't delete more than NUM files

options.name: --max-size
options.description: Don't transfer any file larger than SIZE

options.name: --min-size
options.description: Don't transfer any file smaller than SIZE

options.name: --delay-updates
options.description: Put all updated files into place at transfer's end

options.name: -m
options.description: Prune empty directory chains from the file-list

options.name: --prune-empty-dirs
options.description: Prune empty directory chains from the file-list

options.name: --numeric-ids
options.description: Don't map uid/gid values by user/group name

options.name: --contimeout
options.description: Set daemon connection timeout in seconds

options.name: -I
options.description: Don't skip files that match in size and mod-time

options.name: --ignore-times
options.description: Don't skip files that match in size and mod-time

options.name: -M
options.description: Send OPTION to the remote side only

options.name: --remote-option
options.description: Send OPTION to the remote side only

options.name: --size-only
options.description: Skip files that match in size
Set the accuracy for mod-time comparisons

options.name: --modify-window
options.description: Set the accuracy for mod-time comparisons

options.name: -T
options.description: Create temporary files in directory DIR

options.name: --temp-dir
options.description: Create temporary files in directory DIR

options.name: -y
options.description: Find similar file for basis if no dest file

options.name: --fuzzy
options.description: Find similar file for basis if no dest file

options.name: --compare-dest
options.description: Also compare destination files relative to DIR

options.name: --copy-dest
options.description: Also compare destination files relative to DIR and include copies of unchanged files

options.name: --link-dest
options.description: Hardlink to files in DIR when unchanged

options.name: -z
options.description: Compress file data during the transfer

options.name: --compress
options.description: Compress file data during the transfer

options.name: --skip-compress
options.description: Skip compressing files with a suffix in LIST

options.name: -C
options.description: Auto-ignore files the same way CVS does

options.name: --cvs-exclude
options.description: Auto-ignore files the same way CVS does

options.name: --files-from
options.description: Read list of source-file names from FILE

options.name: --address
options.description: Bind address for outgoing socket to daemon

options.name: --blocking-io
options.description: Use blocking I/O for the remote shell
Leave high-bit chars unescaped in output

options.name: --8-bit-output
options.description: Leave high-bit chars unescaped in output

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help for rsync (-h is --help only if used alone)

options.name: --human-readable
options.description: Output numbers in a human-readable format

options.name: -i
options.description: Output a change-summary for all updates

options.name: --itemize-changes
options.description: Output a change-summary for all updates

options.name: --out-format
options.description: Output updates using the specified FORMAT

options.name: --log-file
options.description: Log what we're doing to the specified FILE

options.name: --log-file-format
options.description: Log updates using the specified FMT

options.name: --list-only
options.description: List the files instead of copying them

options.name: --time-limit
options.description: Stop rsync after MINS minutes have elapsed

options.name: --outbuf
options.description: Set output buffering to None, Line, or Block

options.name: --read-batch
options.description: Read a batched update from FILE

options.name: --protocol
options.description: Force an older protocol version to be used

options.name: --noatime
